description: Bookable food tours, cooking classes, tastings and tickets for a city. Read-only. Each item has price, rating, review count, duration and a tracked `book` link. Ranked by relevance to `query` when given, otherwise by popularity.

city.description: City slug or name, e.g. 'new-york-city' or 'New York City'. Unknown cities answer with did_you_mean.
city.title: City

country.description: Country slug or name, e.g. 'italy'. Optional where city is given.
country.title: Country

food_only.description: Keep only products on the site's theme (food and drink, or wine). Set false for everything bookable in the city.
food_only.title: Food Only

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'cooking class', 'wine tasting', 'market tour'.
query.title: Query

name: experiences
title: Find tours and experiences
